let syncingMailboxes =

| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| where customDimensions has "\\\"trackOption\\\": \\\"0\\\"," 
    and customDimensions has "\\\"changeTypeInRemoteServer\\\": \\\"0\\\","
    and customDimensions has "\\\"changeTypeInCrm\\\": \\\"0\\\","

| parse kind=regex flags=U customDimensions with '\\\\*"MailboxId\\\\*": *\\\\*"'mailboxId:string'\\\\*"'

;
traces                                   
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStat"
| where customDimensions has "\\\"trackOption\\\": \\\"0\\\"," 
    and customDimensions has "\\\"changeTypeInRemoteServer\\\": \\\"0\\\","
    and customDimensions has "\\\"changeTypeInCrm\\\": \\\"0\\\","
    and customDimensions has "\\\"syncStatus\\\": \\\"0\\\","
    and customDimensions !has "\\\"CrmId\\\": \\\"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000\\\","
| parse kind=regex flags=U customDimensions with '\\\\*"mailboxId\\\\*": *\\\\*"'mailboxId:string'\\\\*"'
| where mailboxId in (syncingMailboxes)
| parse kind=regex flags=U customDimensions with '\\\\*"crmId\\\\*": *\\\\*"'crmId:string'\\\\*"'
| where crmId != "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
| parse kind=regex flags=U customDimensions with '\\\\*"timeReceivedInRemoteServer\\\\*": *\\\\*"'timeReceivedInRemoteServer:datetime'\\\\*"'
| parse kind=regex flags=U customDimensions with '\\\\*"timeLastModifiedInRemoteServer\\\\*": *\\\\*"'timeLastModifiedInRemoteServer:datetime'\\\\*"'
| extend timeToSyncFromReceived = timestamp - timeReceivedInRemoteServer
| extend timeToSyncFromModified = timestamp - timeLastModifiedInRemoteServer
| extend timeToSync = min_of(timeToSyncFromModified, timeToSyncFromReceived)
| summarize 
delayedMessages1m = dcountif(crmId, timeToSync > 1m)
,delayedMessages2m = dcountif(crmId, timeToSync > 2m)
,delayedMessages5m = dcountif(crmId, timeToSync > 5m)
,delayedMessages25m = dcountif(crmId, timeToSync > 25m)
,totalMessages = dcount(crmId)  by bin(timestamp,10m)

// --- 1.1 Incoming Email - Full Field Extraction ---
// Extracts ALL available fields from incoming email telemetry
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    messageId = tostring(cd.messageId),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    trackOption = toint(cd.trackOption),
    parentFolderId = tostring(cd.parentFolderId),
    attachmentCount = toint(cd.attachmentCount),
    remoteId = tostring(cd.remoteId),
    emailServerType = tostring(cd.emailServerType),
    emailServiceClientType = tostring(cd.emailServiceClientType),
    traceCode = toint(cd.traceCode),
    traceCodeString = tostring(cd.traceCodeString),
    traceData = tostring(cd.traceData),
    changeTypeInCrm = tostring(cd.changeTypeInCrm),
    changeTypeInRemoteServer = tostring(cd.changeTypeInRemoteServer),
    timeSyncedInCrm = todatetime(cd.timeSyncedInCrm),
    errorSource = tostring(cd.errorSource),
    itemSubject = tostring(cd.itemSubject),
    regardingObjectTypeCode = tostring(cd.regardingObjectTypeCode),
    timeLastModifiedInRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeLastModifiedInRemoteServer),
    timeReceivedInRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeReceivedInRemoteServer)
| extend trackOptionLabel = case(
    trackOption == 0, 'None',
    trackOption == 1, 'AutoTrack',
    trackOption == 2, 'ManualTrack',
    trackOption == 3, 'FolderBasedTrack',
    trackOption == 4, 'RetryFailedAutoTrack',
    'Unknown')
| extend syncStatusLabel = case(
    syncStatus == 0, 'Success',
    syncStatus == 1, 'Failure',
    'Unknown')

// --- 1.2 Incoming Email - Summary by Track Option ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    messageId = tostring(cd.messageId),
    trackOption = toint(cd.trackOption),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus)
| extend trackOptionLabel = case(
    trackOption == 0, 'None',
    trackOption == 1, 'AutoTrack',
    trackOption == 2, 'ManualTrack',
    trackOption == 3, 'FolderBasedTrack',
    trackOption == 4, 'RetryFailedAutoTrack',
    'Unknown')
| summarize
    TotalItems = count(),
    UniqueMessages = dcount(messageId),
    SuccessCount = countif(syncStatus == 0),
    FailureCount = countif(syncStatus == 1)
    by trackOptionLabel
| extend SuccessRate = round(toreal(SuccessCount) / toreal(TotalItems) * 100, 2)

// --- 1.3 Incoming Email - Failure Analysis ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    traceCode = toint(cd.traceCode),
    traceCodeString = tostring(cd.traceCodeString),
    traceData = tostring(cd.traceData),
    errorSource = tostring(cd.errorSource),
    messageId = tostring(cd.messageId)
| where syncStatus != 0
| summarize
    FailureCount = count(),
    AffectedMessages = dcount(messageId),
    SampleTraceData = take_any(traceData)
    by traceCodeString, errorSource
| order by FailureCount desc

// --- 1.4 Incoming Email - Sync Latency (Time to Sync from Remote) ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    messageId = tostring(cd.messageId),
    timeReceivedInRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeReceivedInRemoteServer),
    timeLastModifiedInRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeLastModifiedInRemoteServer)
| where syncStatus == 0
| where timeReceivedInRemoteServer > _startTime - 2h
| extend timeToSync = timestamp - timeReceivedInRemoteServer
| where timeToSync > 0s and timeToSync < 24h // filter anomalies
| summarize
    TotalMessages = dcount(messageId),
    DelayedMessages5m = dcountif(messageId, timeToSync > 5m),
    DelayedMessages25m = dcountif(messageId, timeToSync > 25m),
    P50 = percentiles(timeToSync, 50),
    P75 = percentiles(timeToSync, 75),
    P95 = percentiles(timeToSync, 95),
    P99 = percentiles(timeToSync, 99)
| extend DelayedPercent5m = round(toreal(DelayedMessages5m) / toreal(TotalMessages) * 100, 3)

// --- 1.5 Incoming Email - Sync Latency Trend (10-min buckets) ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    messageId = tostring(cd.messageId),
    trackOption = toint(cd.trackOption),
    timeReceivedInRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeReceivedInRemoteServer)
| where syncStatus == 0
| where trackOption != 0 // exclude loopback/heartbeat
| where timeReceivedInRemoteServer > _startTime - 2h
| extend timeToSync = timestamp - timeReceivedInRemoteServer
| where timeToSync > 0s and timeToSync < 24h
| summarize
    delayedMessages1m = dcountif(messageId, timeToSync > 1m),
    delayedMessages2m = dcountif(messageId, timeToSync > 2m),
    delayedMessages5m = dcountif(messageId, timeToSync > 5m),
    delayedMessages25m = dcountif(messageId, timeToSync > 25m),
    totalMessages = dcount(messageId)
    by bin(timestamp, 10m)

// --- 1.6 Incoming Email - Volume by Hour ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus)
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Success = countif(syncStatus == 0),
    Failure = countif(syncStatus != 0)
    by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend FailureRate = round(toreal(Failure) / toreal(Total) * 100, 2)

// --- 1.7 Incoming Email - Attachment Analysis ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    attachmentCount = toint(cd.attachmentCount),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    messageId = tostring(cd.messageId)
| summarize
    TotalEmails = dcount(messageId),
    EmailsWithAttachments = dcountif(messageId, attachmentCount > 0),
    MaxAttachments = max(attachmentCount),
    AvgAttachments = round(avg(attachmentCount), 1)
| extend AttachmentRate = round(toreal(EmailsWithAttachments) / toreal(TotalEmails) * 100, 1)

// --- 2.1 Outgoing Email - Full Field Extraction ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    messageId = tostring(cd.messageId),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    timeSentInCrm = todatetime(cd.timeSentInCrm),
    timeSyncedToRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeSyncedToRemoteServer),
    timeSyncedInCrm = todatetime(cd.timeSyncedInCrm),
    retryCount = toint(cd.retryCount),
    emailServerType = tostring(cd.emailServerType),
    emailServiceClientType = tostring(cd.emailServiceClientType),
    traceCode = toint(cd.traceCode),
    changeTypeInCrm = tostring(cd.changeTypeInCrm),
    errorSource = tostring(cd.errorSource),
    itemSubject = tostring(cd.itemSubject)
| extend syncStatusLabel = case(
    syncStatus == 0, 'Success',
    syncStatus == 1, 'Failure',
    syncStatus == 2, 'Enqueued',
    'Unknown')

// --- 2.2 Outgoing Email - Summary by Status ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus)
| extend syncStatusLabel = case(
    syncStatus == 0, 'Success',
    syncStatus == 1, 'Failure',
    syncStatus == 2, 'Enqueued',
    'Unknown')
| summarize UniqueEmails = dcount(crmId) by syncStatusLabel

// --- 2.3 Outgoing Email - Sync Latency (P95) ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    timeSentInCrm = todatetime(cd.timeSentInCrm),
    timeSyncedToRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeSyncedToRemoteServer)
| where syncStatus == 0
| where timeSentInCrm > _startTime - 1h
| extend timeToSync = timeSyncedToRemoteServer - timeSentInCrm
| where timeToSync > 0s and timeToSync < 24h
| summarize
    Messages = count(),
    Mailboxes = dcount(mailboxId),
    SyncDelayedMessages5m = countif(timeToSync >= 5m),
    P50 = percentiles(timeToSync, 50),
    P75 = percentiles(timeToSync, 75),
    P95 = percentiles(timeToSync, 95),
    P99 = percentiles(timeToSync, 99),
    P100 = percentiles(timeToSync, 100)
| extend DelayedMessagesPercent = round(toreal(SyncDelayedMessages5m) / toreal(Messages) * 100, 3)

// --- 2.4 Outgoing Email - Sync Latency Trend (10-min buckets) ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    timeSentInCrm = todatetime(cd.timeSentInCrm),
    timeSyncedToRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeSyncedToRemoteServer)
| where syncStatus == 0
| extend timeToSync = timeSyncedToRemoteServer - timeSentInCrm
| where timeToSync > 0s and timeToSync < 24h
| summarize
    delayedMessages1m = dcountif(crmId, timeToSync > 1m),
    delayedMessages2m = dcountif(crmId, timeToSync > 2m),
    delayedMessages5m = dcountif(crmId, timeToSync > 5m),
    delayedMessages25m = dcountif(crmId, timeToSync > 25m),
    totalMessages = dcount(crmId)
    by bin(timestamp, 10m)

// --- 2.5 Outgoing Email - Retry Analysis ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    retryCount = toint(cd.retryCount),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus)
| summarize
    TotalEmails = dcount(crmId),
    EmailsWithRetries = dcountif(crmId, retryCount > 0),
    MaxRetries = max(retryCount),
    AvgRetries = round(avg(retryCount), 2)
    by syncStatusLabel = case(syncStatus == 0, 'Success', syncStatus == 1, 'Failure', 'Other')

// --- 2.6 Outgoing Email - Per-Mailbox Performance ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    timeSentInCrm = todatetime(cd.timeSentInCrm),
    timeSyncedToRemoteServer = todatetime(cd.timeSyncedToRemoteServer)
| where syncStatus == 0
| extend timeToSync = timeSyncedToRemoteServer - timeSentInCrm
| where timeToSync > 0s and timeToSync < 24h
| summarize
    EmailCount = dcount(crmId),
    P95_Latency = percentiles(timeToSync, 95),
    AvgLatency = avg(timeToSync)
    by mailboxId
| order by EmailCount desc
| take 20

// --- 2.7 Outgoing Email - Failure Details ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId),
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    traceCode = toint(cd.traceCode),
    errorSource = tostring(cd.errorSource),
    itemSubject = tostring(cd.itemSubject)
| where syncStatus != 0
| summarize
    FailureCount = count(),
    AffectedEmails = dcount(crmId),
    AffectedMailboxes = dcount(mailboxId),
    SampleSubject = take_any(itemSubject)
    by traceCode, errorSource
| order by FailureCount desc

// --- 3.1 ACT - Full Field Extraction ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogAppointmentContactTaskItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmEntityTypeCode = tostring(cd.crmEntityTypeCode),
    crmChangeType = tostring(cd.crmChangeType),
    remoteChangeType = tostring(cd.remoteChangeType),
    crmModifiedTime = todatetime(cd.crmModifiedTime),
    remoteModifiedTime = todatetime(cd.remoteModifiedTime),
    crmAction = tostring(cd.crmAction),
    remoteAction = tostring(cd.remoteAction),
    crmSyncState = tostring(cd.crmSyncState),
    remoteSyncState = tostring(cd.remoteSyncState),
    syncTime = todatetime(cd.syncTime),
    remoteMappingId = tostring(cd.remoteMappingId),
    retryCount = toint(cd.retryCount),
    lastErrorMessage = tostring(cd.lastErrorMessage),
    lastErrorCode = tostring(cd.lastErrorCode),
    lastErrorCodeMessage = tostring(cd.lastErrorCodeMessage),
    lastErrorTime = todatetime(cd.lastErrorTime),
    lastSyncException = tostring(cd.lastSyncException),
    organizationId = tostring(cd.organizationId),
    mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    messageId = tostring(cd.messageId),
    remoteId = tostring(cd.remoteId),
    asyncEventId = tostring(cd.asyncEventId),
    emailServerType = tostring(cd.emailServerType),
    emailServiceClientType = tostring(cd.emailServiceClientType)

// --- 3.2 ACT - Summary by Entity Type ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogAppointmentContactTaskItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmEntityTypeCode = tostring(cd.crmEntityTypeCode),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId)
| summarize
    TotalItems = count(),
    UniqueItems = dcount(crmId)
    by crmEntityTypeCode
| order by TotalItems desc

// --- 3.3 ACT - Sync Scenario Analysis ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogAppointmentContactTaskItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmEntityTypeCode = tostring(cd.crmEntityTypeCode),
    crmChangeType = tostring(cd.crmChangeType),
    remoteChangeType = tostring(cd.remoteChangeType),
    crmAction = tostring(cd.crmAction),
    remoteAction = tostring(cd.remoteAction),
    crmSyncState = tostring(cd.crmSyncState),
    remoteSyncState = tostring(cd.remoteSyncState),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId)
| extend Scenario = strcat(crmEntityTypeCode, '-[', crmChangeType, '-', remoteChangeType, ']->[', crmAction, '-', remoteAction, ']=[', crmSyncState, '-', remoteSyncState, ']')
| summarize ItemCount = dcount(crmId) by Scenario
| order by ItemCount desc
| take 20

// --- 3.4 ACT - Sync Latency by Entity Type ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogAppointmentContactTaskItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmEntityTypeCode = tostring(cd.crmEntityTypeCode),
    crmModifiedTime = todatetime(cd.crmModifiedTime),
    remoteModifiedTime = todatetime(cd.remoteModifiedTime),
    syncTime = todatetime(cd.syncTime),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId)
| where crmModifiedTime < _endTime + 1h
| where remoteModifiedTime < _endTime + 1h
| extend ReferenceChangeTime = min_of(crmModifiedTime, remoteModifiedTime)
| where ReferenceChangeTime > _startTime - 1h
| extend TimeToSync = syncTime - ReferenceChangeTime
| where TimeToSync > 0s and TimeToSync < 24h
| summarize
    TotalItems = dcount(crmId),
    SyncDelayedItems8m = dcountif(crmId, TimeToSync >= 8m),
    SyncDelayedItems12m = dcountif(crmId, TimeToSync >= 12m),
    P50 = percentiles(TimeToSync, 50),
    P75 = percentiles(TimeToSync, 75),
    P95 = percentiles(TimeToSync, 95),
    P99 = percentiles(TimeToSync, 99)
    by crmEntityTypeCode
| extend DelayedPercent = round(toreal(SyncDelayedItems12m) / toreal(TotalItems) * 100, 3)

// --- 3.5 ACT - Error Analysis ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogAppointmentContactTaskItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmEntityTypeCode = tostring(cd.crmEntityTypeCode),
    lastErrorCode = tostring(cd.lastErrorCode),
    lastErrorCodeMessage = tostring(cd.lastErrorCodeMessage),
    lastErrorMessage = tostring(cd.lastErrorMessage),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId),
    mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId)
| where isnotempty(lastErrorCode) and lastErrorCode != "0"
| summarize
    ErrorCount = count(),
    AffectedItems = dcount(crmId),
    AffectedMailboxes = dcount(mailboxId),
    SampleMessage = take_any(lastErrorMessage)
    by crmEntityTypeCode, lastErrorCode, lastErrorCodeMessage
| order by ErrorCount desc

// --- 3.6 ACT - Sync Direction Analysis (CRM vs Remote initiated) ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogAppointmentContactTaskItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    crmEntityTypeCode = tostring(cd.crmEntityTypeCode),
    crmChangeType = tostring(cd.crmChangeType),
    remoteChangeType = tostring(cd.remoteChangeType),
    crmId = tostring(cd.crmId)
| extend SyncDirection = case(
    crmChangeType != "0" and remoteChangeType == "0", "CRM → Remote",
    crmChangeType == "0" and remoteChangeType != "0", "Remote → CRM",
    crmChangeType != "0" and remoteChangeType != "0", "Bidirectional",
    "None/Heartbeat")
| summarize ItemCount = dcount(crmId) by crmEntityTypeCode, SyncDirection
| order by crmEntityTypeCode, ItemCount desc

// --- 4.1 Overall SSS Health Summary ---
// Single-pane overview of all sync operations
let incoming = traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| summarize
    IncomingTotal = count(),
    IncomingSuccess = countif(toint(cd.syncStatus) == 0),
    IncomingFailure = countif(toint(cd.syncStatus) != 0),
    IncomingUniqueMessages = dcount(tostring(cd.messageId));
let outgoing = traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| summarize
    OutgoingTotal = count(),
    OutgoingSuccess = countif(toint(cd.syncStatus) == 0),
    OutgoingFailure = countif(toint(cd.syncStatus) != 0),
    OutgoingUniqueEmails = dcount(tostring(cd.crmId));
let act = traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message == "LogAppointmentContactTaskItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| summarize
    ACTTotal = count(),
    ACTUniqueItems = dcount(tostring(cd.crmId));
incoming | join kind=cross (outgoing) on 1==1 | join kind=cross (act) on 1==1
| project
    IncomingTotal, IncomingSuccess, IncomingFailure, IncomingUniqueMessages,
    IncomingSuccessRate = round(toreal(IncomingSuccess)/toreal(IncomingTotal)*100, 1),
    OutgoingTotal, OutgoingSuccess, OutgoingFailure, OutgoingUniqueEmails,
    OutgoingSuccessRate = round(toreal(OutgoingSuccess)/toreal(OutgoingTotal)*100, 1),
    ACTTotal, ACTUniqueItems

// --- 4.2 Active Syncing Mailboxes Count ---
// Equivalent to CloudSSS "Active Mailbox" tiles
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message in ("LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights", "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights")
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId)
| where isnotempty(mailboxId)
| summarize
    IncomingMailboxes = dcountif(mailboxId, message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"),
    OutgoingMailboxes = dcountif(mailboxId, message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"),
    TotalActiveMailboxes = dcount(mailboxId)

// --- 4.3 Sync Volume Trend - All Types (Hourly) ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message in (
    "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights",
    "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights",
    "LogAppointmentContactTaskItemStatForAppInsights")
| extend MetricType = case(
    message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights", "Incoming",
    message == "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights", "Outgoing",
    "ACT")
| summarize Count = count() by MetricType, bin(timestamp, 1h)

// --- 4.4 Error Rate Trend - All Types (Hourly) ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message in (
    "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights",
    "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights")
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    MetricType = iif(message has "Incoming", "Incoming", "Outgoing")
| summarize
    Total = count(),
    Failures = countif(syncStatus != 0)
    by MetricType, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| extend FailureRate = round(toreal(Failures) / toreal(Total) * 100, 2)

// --- 4.5 Top Error Codes Across All Sync Types ---
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message in (
    "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights",
    "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights")
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    syncStatus = toint(cd.syncStatus),
    traceCode = tostring(cd.traceCode),
    traceCodeString = tostring(cd.traceCodeString),
    errorSource = tostring(cd.errorSource)
| where syncStatus != 0
| extend MetricType = iif(message has "Incoming", "Incoming", "Outgoing")
| summarize ErrorCount = count() by MetricType, traceCode, traceCodeString, errorSource

// --- 4.6 Email Service Client Type Distribution ---
// Shows REST vs EWS usage patterns
traces
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where message in (
    "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights",
    "LogOutgoingEmailItemStatForAppInsights")
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend
    emailServiceClientType = tostring(cd.emailServiceClientType),
    MetricType = iif(message has "Incoming", "Incoming", "Outgoing")
| extend ClientTypeLabel = case(
    emailServiceClientType == "0", "EWS",
    emailServiceClientType == "3", "REST",
    strcat("Type-", emailServiceClientType))
| summarize Count = count() by MetricType, ClientTypeLabel

// --- 4.7 Loopback Detection (Heartbeat Mailboxes) ---
// Identifies mailboxes that are syncing but only processing heartbeat/loopback items
let loopbackStartTime = _startTime - 2h;
let syncingMailboxes =
traces
| where timestamp between(loopbackStartTime.._startTime)
| where message == "LogIncomingEmailItemStatForAppInsights"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| where toint(cd.trackOption) == 0
    and tostring(cd.changeTypeInRemoteServer) == "0"
    and tostring(cd.changeTypeInCrm) == "0"
    and toint(cd.syncStatus) == 0
| extend mailboxId = tostring(cd.mailboxId)
| where isnotempty(mailboxId)
| distinct mailboxId;
syncingMailboxes
| summarize HeartbeatMailboxes = count()

// --- 4.8 Page Views - Form Load Performance (from PageView dashboard pattern) ---
pageViews
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| where tostring(cd.pageName) == "EditForm"
| extend LoadTypeSimple = iif(toint(cd.loadType) == 0, "Cold", "Warm")
| extend entityName = tostring(cd.entityName)
| summarize
    ColdCount = countif(LoadTypeSimple == "Cold"),
    WarmCount = countif(LoadTypeSimple == "Warm"),
    TotalCount = count(),
    AvgColdLoad = round(avgif(duration, LoadTypeSimple == "Cold")),
    AvgWarmLoad = round(avgif(duration, LoadTypeSimple == "Warm")),
    MaxColdLoad = maxif(duration, LoadTypeSimple == "Cold"),
    MaxWarmLoad = maxif(duration, LoadTypeSimple == "Warm")
    by entityName
| order by TotalCount desc
| take 20

// --- 4.9 Plugin Performance (from PageView dashboard pattern) ---
dependencies
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where type == "Plugin"
| where name !startswith "Microsoft"
| extend executionTimeInMS = todouble(duration)
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| extend depth = toint(cd.depth)
| where success == "True"
| summarize
    P50 = percentiles(executionTimeInMS, 50),
    P90 = percentiles(executionTimeInMS, 90),
    P95 = percentiles(executionTimeInMS, 95),
    NumOfRequests = count(),
    MaxDepth = max(depth),
    AvgExecutionTime = toint(avg(executionTimeInMS))
    by name
| order by NumOfRequests desc
| take 20

// --- 4.10 Plugin Failure Rate (from PageView dashboard pattern) ---
dependencies
| where timestamp between(_startTime.._endTime)
| where type == "Plugin"
| extend cd = parse_json(customDimensions)
| project timestamp, success, typeName = tostring(cd.pluginType)
| summarize
    NumberOfRequests = count(),
    Passed = dcountif(timestamp, success == "True"),
    Failed = dcountif(timestamp, success == "False")
    by typeName
| extend FailureRate = round(toreal(Failed) / toreal(NumberOfRequests) * 100, 2)
| where Failed > 0
| order by Failed desc
| take 10
